description: Create one inventory organization in Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM.
notes: OrganizationId is generated by Oracle when the organization is created, so this runner keeps it out of the request payload.
For POST/create, use ID fields such as ManagementBusinessUnitId and LegalEntityId. Name fields from GET response are treated as read-only and should not be uploaded.
Use Reference Finder to download Business Unit, Legal Entity, Inventory Organization, and Location IDs from the target instance before filling the upload template.
Use Mock/Dry Run mode first before posting to DEV/TEST/PROD.

fields.label: Organization Code
fields.description: Short code that uniquely identifies the organization.

fields.label: Organization Name
fields.description: Name of the organization.

fields.label: Management Business Unit Name
fields.description: Business unit name used by Oracle example payload. Read-only saat POST; gunakan ManagementBusinessUnitId.

fields.label: Management Business Unit ID
fields.description: ID Business Unit untuk management BU. Ambil dari Reference Finder sheet Business Units.

fields.label: Legal Entity Name
fields.description: Legal entity name used by Oracle example payload. Read-only saat POST; gunakan LegalEntityId.

fields.label: Legal Entity ID
fields.description: ID Legal Entity. Ambil dari Reference Finder sheet Legal Entities.

fields.label: Profit Center Business Unit Name
fields.description: Profit center business unit name used by Oracle example payload. Read-only saat POST; gunakan ProfitCenterBusinessUnitId.

fields.label: Profit Center Business Unit ID
fields.description: ID Business Unit untuk profit center BU. Biasanya bisa sama dengan ManagementBusinessUnitId, tergantung setup.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Status, commonly Active.

fields.label: Location ID
fields.description: ID lokasi inventory organization. Ambil dari Reference Finder sheet Locations LOV kalau endpoint tersedia, atau dari existing organization.

fields.label: Inventory Flag
fields.description: Must be supplied when creating an organization. true = inventory organization.

fields.label: Master Organization ID
fields.description: ID master/reference inventory organization. Ambil dari Reference Finder sheet Inventory Organizations LOV.

fields.label: Master Organization Code
fields.description: Parent/master organization code alternative.

fields.label: Manufacturing Plant Flag
fields.description: true if the organization is a manufacturing plant.

fields.label: Contract Manufacturing Flag
fields.description: true if the organization is a contract manufacturing plant.

fields.label: Maintenance Enabled Flag
fields.description: true if the organization performs maintenance activities.

fields.label: Integrated System Type
fields.description: Optional integration relationship code.

fields.label: Item Grouping Code
fields.description: How the application assigns items to an organization.

fields.label: Item Definition Organization Name
fields.description: Definition organization name used when item grouping is reference organization. Read-only saat POST; gunakan ItemDefinitionOrganizationId.

fields.label: Item Definition Organization ID
fields.description: ID item definition organization. Ambil dari Reference Finder sheet Inventory Organizations LOV atau existing org.

fields.label: Inventory Org Parameters - Schedule ID
fields.description: Workday calendar/schedule ID for inventory organization parameters.

fields.label: Plant Parameters - Manufacturing Calendar ID
fields.description: Manufacturing calendar ID. Required when plantParameters is supplied.

fields.label: Plant Parameters - Default Supply Subinventory
fields.description: Default supply subinventory for backflushing.

fields.label: Plant Parameters - Default Completion Subinventory
fields.description: Default completion subinventory.

fields.label: Plant Parameters - Enable Process Manufacturing Flag
fields.description: true to enable process manufacturing.

fields.label: Plant Parameters - Default Work Method
fields.description: Default work method.

fields.label: Organization ID
fields.description: Generated by Oracle when the organization is created; kept out of request payload.
